content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NHM Kalahandi Nutritionist cum Counsellor - NRC Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHM Kalahandi Nutritionist cum Counsellor - NRC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. The interview is scheduled for 25 August 2026. Candidates should report on this date for registration and the interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Nutritionist cum Counsellor - NRC post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Nutritionist cum Counsellor - NRC position in the National Health Mission Kalahandi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree in Food and Nutrition or Home Science (Hons/ pass). Additionally, the candidate must be a lady.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Nutritionist cum Counsellor - NRC post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 65 years. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories as per norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Nutritionist cum Counsellor - NRC position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 21,782, along with other applicable incentives as per OSH & FW society norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Computer Test, Group Discussion, and a Personal Interview. Candidates must perform well in all stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NHM Kalahandi recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted in Kalahandi, Odisha. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a government job?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a contractual job under the National Health Mission Kalahandi, which is a government initiative.
